title: Compute brief — 11 September 2026
description: NVIDIA Australia up-to-2 GW DSX partner slate; China AI chip indicated prices jump on HBM squeeze. PUCT 58481 still on today’s open-meeting clock. Silicon Tape confirm day — Lambda H100 $3.99 / B200 $6.69; 56 confirms, 0 ticks.
og_kicker: AUS 2 GW slate; CHN HBM squeeze
lede: Conversion prints landed outside Texas overnight while Austin’s permanent ≥75 MW rule is still on the morning clock. NVIDIA’s 9 Sep Newsroom release named eight Australian partners (Firmus, Sharon AI, IREN, Megaport, ResetData, CDC, NEXTDC, AirTrunk) for up to 2 GW of DSX AI-factory capacity by 2027 — a national MW target tied to named operators, still power-gated. Separately, Reuters (10 Sep) reported Chinese AI chipmakers including Huawei and Cambricon lifting indicated accelerator prices 20–50% as grey-market HBM costs bite after Dec 2024 advanced-HBM export curbs. In Texas, PUCT Project 58481 (staff’s 3 Sep recommended adoption of new 16 TAC §25.194: $50k/MW security, forfeiture cut 80%→20%, interconnection fee removed) remains Item 24 on the 11 Sep open meeting; Interchange showed no 11 Sep adoption filing as of this morning’s scrape. The Silicon Tape is another clean confirm: Lambda H100 $3.99 and B200 $6.69 unchanged across 56 re-read list prints.
